# Design Tokens Pro

> Digital guide for building scalable design systems with design tokens.
> For designers and developers. Author: Francesco Improta.
> Formats: online + printable PDF.

Design Tokens Pro covers taxonomy, naming conventions, token architecture,
themes/color modes, lifecycle management, and documentation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.designtokens.pro/): Guide overview, chapters, FAQ, pricing
- [Home (Markdown)](https://www.designtokens.pro/index.md): Same content as plain Markdown
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.designtokens.pro/privacy): Data handling and cookies
- [Privacy (Markdown)](https://www.designtokens.pro/privacy.md): Same content as plain Markdown
